observation.visible_scene: A close-up view of a spherical object covered in a thick, colorful, viscous substance. The coating consists primarily of bright green and blue hues in the center and right, with a section of yellow visible on the left side. The surface of the green and blue mixture is textured with numerous small bubbles. The object sits on a blurred, light-brown surface against a dark, out-of-focus background.
visible_changes: The green and blue fluid layer shifts very slowly across the surface of the sphere.
The positions and appearances of the bubbles on the surface change subtly.
The boundary where the green fluid meets the yellow section on the left moves slightly as the fluid flows.
A drip forming at the bottom right edge of the object changes shape marginally.
outside_clip_unknowns: The method used to apply the mixture to the object.
The composition of the materials (e.g., paint, slime, food coloring).
The state of the object before the coating was applied and what happens after the clip ends.
uncertain_details: Whether the minimal motion is entirely due to the fluid's viscosity or if there is slight camera movement.
The exact nature of the object underneath the coating.
